gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 514.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured red on Drawing No. HH 3616, joining Aberdeen Main Road near the east of Aberdeen Wholesale Fish Market, running in a north-westerly direction for about 160 m and terminating at its junction with Shek Pai Wan Road about 45 m west of Tin Wan Hill Road. Proposed Name: ABERDEEN PRAYA ROAD. Chinese Version: 香港仔海旁道.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路在香港仔魚類批發市場東面附近與香港仔大道連接，向西北伸展約一六〇米，終點在田灣山道西面約四十五米處與石排灣道會合，其位置在 HH 3616 號圖則內用紅色標明。

history.submitter_remarks: Gazette ZH 香港仔海旁道; geojson 香港仔海傍道.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 514.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured yellow on Drawing No. HH 3616, commencing at the junction of Shek Pai Wan Road and Tin Wan Hill Road, running in a south-westerly direction for about 23 m and terminating at its junction with the road shown coloured red on the said Drawing. Proposed Name: TIN WAN HILL ROAD. Chinese Version: 田灣山道.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路之位置在 HH 3616 號圖則內用黃色標明，由石排灣道與田灣山道之連接處開始，向西南伸展約廿三米，終點與在上述圖則內以紅色標明之道路會合。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 514.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured green on Drawing No. HH 3616, commencing at its junction with the road shown coloured red on the said Drawing, running in a westerly direction for about 120 m and terminating in front of the Sewage Screening Plant. Proposed Name: TIN WAN PRAYA ROAD. Chinese Version: 田灣海旁道.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路之位置在 HH 3616 號圖則內用綠色標明，由與在上述圖則內用紅色標明之道路連接處開始，向西伸展約一百二十米，並在污水隔濾廠前終結。
